- **Base:** `devin/p30-3-national-export-and-public-cutover` @ `065d8aa` (pushed to origin before branching; the
  remote was one commit behind at `2a6f249`)
- **Branch:** `devin/p30-4-post-launch-closeout`
- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; `live_verification=true`; autonomous=true. **Gate:** engineering, with no
  hard human gate. The operator's GATE-ACCEPT-style sign-off is prepared as a readout and left **pending**.
- **ADR:** ADR-107 (Cloud SQL steady-state tier). It answers ADR-102's revisit trigger without editing
  ADR-102.

- To re-verify DONE: D-SOURCES.17-1, D-P27.1-1, D-R6.2/6.3/6.4/6.5/6.6, D-R7.2-DETECTORS, D-P27.4-1,
  D-P27.8-1, D-P30.2-3.

  D-P30.3-COUNSEL (stays OPEN), D-R6.1-EVAL (first-principles half stays OPEN), and every other OPEN row.

## Requirements (contract + operator brief)

1. Scale `sig-pg` down from `db-custom-2-8192` to the smallest tier that safely serves the live read load. Measure
   first, justify the choice, record it with its cost in a new ADR, patch `--quiet`, check `RUNNABLE`, then
   re-verify both public URLs and `probe-hosted`. Confirm that the static site was unaffected.
2. Re-verify every go-live deferral that P30.1–P30.3 closed, against live evidence.
3. Sweep the live deferrals honestly: D-R7.3-BREADTH run or precisely recorded; D-R7.2-SEND, D-P21.7-1,
   D-P30.3-COUNSEL and the D-R6.1-EVAL first-principles half stay open; every OPEN row names its blocker.
4. A dated launch record under `docs/build/reports/`.
5. The whole-build capstone: `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 make check`, `tests/db`, `tests/e2e`, `npm --prefix web run
   check`, the coverage matrix, and an ACCEPTED-deviations list for operator sign-off.
6. `projectStatus` per BM-TAIL-03 only if the rule holds. The GATE-ACCEPT signature is the operator's.
7. Close the ticket: LEDGER, PHASE LOG, BUILD_INDEX row 139, run ledger, PR body, validators green.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: every go-live deferral closed by P30.1–P30.3 is verified DONE with evidence (live-verified).
- AC2: the remaining live deferrals are swept honestly: D-R7.3-BREADTH run or precisely recorded; D-R7.2-SEND
  still operator-gated; D-P21.7-1 still deferred (HG-08); every OPEN row names its precise blocker.
- AC3: the launch is recorded; the capstone is green (composed e2e under `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`, coverage,
  `make check`); no assertion loosened; no xfail flipped.
- AC4: `projectStatus` is set per BM-TAIL-03 with a justification; build memory green; no merge, tag or
  push to `main`.
- Invariants: no spine writes; no gate ticked on the operator's behalf; secrets only in env; nothing
  fabricated.

## Plan

Start the long local gates in the background (make check → tests/e2e + tests/db → web check). Meanwhile,
measure the hosted read path read-only (Cloud Monitoring 24 h CPU/memory/IO; a latency probe of the
`PgReadStore` query shapes; `sig-api` endpoint timings). Pick the tier, patch it, and re-probe. Re-verify the
deferrals with read-only hosted counts. Check D-R7.3-BREADTH's precondition (`CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`). Write
ADR-107, the launch record, the capstone report, the accepted-deviations readout and the DEFERRALS sweep.
Close the ticket.

## Progress

- Base pushed (`2a6f249..065d8aa`); branch created.
- Local gates run in the background (results in the evidence log).
- Cloud Monitoring (24 h, hourly max) on `db-custom-2-8192`: CPU 7–50 % (peaks at the materialization and export
  jobs), memory ~3.9 GB (~2.6 GB of it `shared_buffers`). On `db-f1-micro` before the scale-up, memory
  utilization was pinned at 1.0.
- Latency probe (`read_probe.py`, read-only, through `cloud-sql-proxy`): see ADR-107's table.
- A first `/v1/search?q=flock` hung. Cloud Run logged "maximum request timeout". Cause: an unanchored `ILIKE`
  plus N+1 lookups with no LIMIT → **D-P30.4-2**.
- Tier decision: **`db-custom-1-3840`**, the smallest dedicated-core tier (reasons in ADR-107). Patched 17:04:04Z →
  `RUNNABLE` 17:09:02Z.
- After the restart, `sig-api` DB endpoints returned 500 (stale psycopg connection) → **D-P30.4-1**. A
  label-only update rolled revision `sig-api-00003-ffl` onto a different `:latest` digest (`ebb6dab9…`, built
  2026-09-22). It was replaced at once by `sig-api-00004-jdj`, pinned to the digest that had been serving
  (`cc680111…`), so the restart changed no running code.
- Post-restart: `probe-hosted` 7/7 ok; both origins green; `sig-web` served 200 mid-restart.
- Deferral re-verification (read-only): all 11 still DONE (capstone §3).
- D-R7.3-BREADTH: all 8 sources map to `None` in `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`; a live run stops with "no connector
  known" before any socket. Not run; the precise remainder is recorded.
- ENTITY-RACE-01 was re-checked: 3 `(scheme, value)` pairs map to 2 entities each (the camilo pair plus
  `us.state OK`, `fr.insee 01`, not triaged). Promoted to **D-P30.4-3**.
- The armed leak check fails on 45 committed files that predate P30.4 → **D-P30.4-4**. The launch record was
  written with `$SIG_GCP_PROJECT`, so P30.4 adds no occurrence.
- BUILD_INDEX was missing row 87 (P24.9 GATE-ACCEPT marker) → a retro row is added by the close commit (with row 139).
- An independent fresh-context review (Phase 3 Pass 2 + gap walk) found no honesty or append-only problems. Fixed:
  (B1) the close writes were claimed before the close commit, so the wording is now "close commit";
  (S1) ADR-107 now separates the f1-micro and 2-8192 memory windows, adds the 5.57 GB peak, and adds the memory
  measured after the change (2.03 GB, util 0.53); (S2) the cold figures were added; (S3) `/v1/changes` stayed 200
  because it makes no query; (S4/S5) the BM-TAIL-03 reasoning now leads with the unsigned readout and states
  BL-055's real landing (`P25.1`); (N1) the P30.3-sourced launch figures are labelled.
